summary: Two hikers overdue on the Mount Blanca Massif; last seen at the Holbrook Creek crossing 7/26 at 20:30 after separating from their party to camp another night at Lake Como. AVSAR paged ~15:30 sent two 4x4 truck teams up Lake Como Road through weather-caused rockslides; the hikers were found at Lake Como healthy and safe and reunited with family and friends at 20:55.
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer Search and Rescue; Alamosa County Sheriff
